# 1D scan results

- `scan.png` — LLHD scan across eField at nominal detector parameters.
- `scan_summary.csv` — per-parameter closure results summarized in one row per parameter (this is retained because it is the compact table cited in the final 1D report). Field definitions in the top row.
- `scan_summary.json` — compact JSON summary for the eField axis only.

Source: `.local/one_d/eField_scan_history.pkl` (single authoritative PKL).
Regenerated by: `workflows/one_d/run_scan_analysis.py`.
